Method.Implementation: Set %code=0 #; don't generate any code if it's not for a query If %mode="method" Quit $$$OK $$$comClassKeyGetLvar(schema,%class,$$$cCLASSsqlschemaname) $$$comMemberKeyGetLvar(proc,%class,$$$cCLASSquery,%property,$$$cQUERYsqlname) Set SCHEMAQ = $$quoter^%occClass($$$ucase(schema)) Set PROCQ = $$quoter^%occClass($$$ucase(proc)) #; Generate code to check to see if the GetInfo data has already been compiled... #; Metadata versions are currently as follows: #; DPV2695 (07/11/2006) - %protocol cleanup - remove all %protocol < 39 code #; Version 1: %protocol < 15; NO LONGER SUPPORTED!! Old colinfo (in colinfo1) and Old parminfo (parminfo2) (metadata1) #; Version 2: %protocol < 31, >14; New colinfo (in colinfo) and Old parminfo (parminfo2) (metadata2) #; Version 3: %protocol < 41, >30; New colinfo (in colinfo) and new parminfo (parminfo) (metadata3) #; Version 4: %protocol > 40; (current version) New colinfo (in colinfo)+bstr and new parminfo (parminfo) (metadata4) $$$GENERATE(" set version = $Select($Get(%protocol,41)>40:4,1:3)") $$$GENERATE(" $$$SQLQueryOdbcItem("_SCHEMAQ_","_PROCQ_",4,""metadata"")") $$$GENERATE(" Set colcount=$li(metadata,2),cmdlen=colcount*10,parmcount=$li(metadata,3+cmdlen),pmdlen=parmcount*6,parminfo=$li(metadata,cmdlen+3,cmdlen+pmdlen+3)") $$$GENERATE(" If version=4 {") $$$GENERATE(" Set colinfo=$li(metadata,2,2+cmdlen)") $$$GENERATE(" } Else {") $$$GENERATE(" Set colinfo=$li(metadata,2,2)") $$$GENERATE(" For i=0:1:colcount-1 Set colinfo=colinfo_$list(metadata,3+(i*10),11+(i*10))") $$$GENERATE(" }") $$$GENERATE(" Quit $$$OK") Quit $$$OK

Method.name: WriteClass
Method.Implementation:
New %path Kill %pxw1 #dim ele,element as PXW.DEV.Element Set zh=$ZHOROLOG Set showPaths=0,forceXref=0 Write "
"
	; Debug is only for the DISPLAY of the page, if you want to debug the parsing use the ParserTest page.
	If +Debug=1 $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Tools.Debugger).%ClassName(1))
	If Debug["$FILE" $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Debuggers.BasicToFile).%ClassName(1)) 
	If Debug["$PATHS" Set showPaths=1,%path="" ; no need to set any output its just for tooltips
	If Debug["$TIME" $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Tools.DebugTiming).%ClassName(1))
	If Debug["$XREF" Set forceXref=1
	
    Set output=##class(PXW.Tools.DEV.HTML.bnf).%New()
	Set output.ThisType=..#CodeType
	Set output.FormatEmbeddedSQl=$SELECT($$$UPPER(FormatOptions)["NOSQLFORMATTING":0,1:1)
	Set output.ClassServer=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).OpenNamespace(%NS)
	Set sc=output.ClassServer.GetClassStudioText(ClassName,.text,.linesOfCode,.timestamp)
	Set zh(1,"load")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

	If $$$ISOK(sc) {
		If Debug'="" {
			; display the original text from the server
			Write "
"
			;w text
			Set ln=""
			For  {
				Set ln=$ORDER(linesOfCode(ln))
				Quit:ln=""
				Write !,""_ln_":"_""_..EscapeHTML(linesOfCode(ln))
			} 
			Write "
"
		}
		Set zh(2,"display")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

   		Set x=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.ClassDefinition).%New()
		Set x.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text)
		Set zh=$ZHOROLOG

		Set output.This=ClassName
		Set output.HiLiteLine=hiliteLineNo
		Set output.BookMark=bookMark
		Set output.showPaths=showPaths
        Do output.begin()
		Set scratch=output
		Set zh(4,"render start")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

		If Debug'="$TIME" $$$DEBUGPause
		Set pzh=$ZHOROLOG,ptot=0
		Set ozh=$ZHOROLOG,otot=0
		Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
		While x.cheese(element) {
			Set ptot=ptot+($ZHOROLOG-pzh)
			$$$DEBUGResume
			Set ozh=$ZHOROLOG
			Do output.middle(element)
			Set otot=otot+($ZHOROLOG-ozh)
			If Debug'="$TIME" $$$DEBUGPause
			Set pzh=$ZHOROLOG

			If Debug["$WRITE" {
				ZWrite output.Analyser
				Do element.write()
			}


			Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
			;zw output.Analyser
		}
		$$$DEBUGResume

		Set zh(4.5,"render parse")=ptot
		Set zh(4.6,"render output")=otot

		If 'x.stream.EOF() {
			Write ""
			Do ..WriteStatus($$$ERROR(5001,"Not at end:line="_x.stream.line_":pos="_x.stream.pos_":lastPos="_x.stream.lastPos_":length="_x.stream.length_":"_$EXTRACT(x.stream.input,x.stream.pos,x.stream.lastPos)_"."))
			Write ""
			Do output.AddToIndex(" Unfinished parse","ERROR","unfinishedParse")
			Do output.AddToIndexError(" Unfinished parse","Unfinished parsing")
		}

		Do output.end()

		Set zh(5,"render end")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

		If forceXref {
			$$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Tools.Debugger).%New())
			$$$DEBUG("Xref build")
			Do ##class(PXW.Xref.Build).Build(%NS,"CLS",ClassName,1,1)
			$$$DEBUGStop
		} Else {
			Do ##class(PXW.Xref.Build).Build(%NS,"CLS",ClassName,0)
		}

		Set zh(6,"xref")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG
		Kill element,x,output

	} Else {
		Do ..WriteStatus(sc)
		Do ##class(PXW.Xref.Build).Build(%NS,"CLS",ClassName,forceXref)
	}

	
	If Debug["$TIME" {
		Set s="" For  Set s=$ORDER(%pxwstrings(s),1,n) Quit:s=""  Set %pxwstringsX(n,s)=""
		Write "
" ZWrite %punct,%pxwstrings,%pxwstringsX,%pxw1,%RBCOUNT ZWrite $$$debugObject Write "
"
		Set totaltime=0,totalcalls=0
		Set rs=##clasS(%Library.ResultSet).%New("PXW.Tools.DebugTiming:SelectResults")
		$$$THROWONERROR(sc,rs.%Execute())
		&html<>
		While rs.%Next() {
			Set time=rs.Get("TotalTime"),totaltime=totaltime+time
			Set calls=rs.Get("CountOfCalls"),totalcalls=totalcalls+calls
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write "",!
		}
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write "",!
		&html<

			
ClassNameMethodNameTotalTimeCountOfCallsAverageTimePercentageOfTime
"_..EscapeHTML(rs.Get("ClassName"))_""_""_..EscapeHTML(rs.Get("MethodName"))_""_""_$JUSTIFY(time,0,6)_""_calls_""_$JUSTIFY(rs.Get("AverageTime"),0,6)_""_$JUSTIFY(rs.Get("PercentageOfTime"),0,6)_"
Total"_""_""_$JUSTIFY(totaltime,0,6)_""_totalcalls_""_""_""_""_"
>
	} Else {
		;w "
" zw %pxwstrings,%pxwstringsX,%pxw1 
		;w !,"$s="_$s
		;w "
"
		
	}
	If Debug="$FILE" {
		ZWrite %pxwdebug
	}

	;ZWrite %peek
	;zw %atoms
	;d %session.EndSession()
	;zw zh,%RBCOUNT
    Write "
"

----- P1 (classname) Kill atoms ;Set flat1=..flattenlist(p1,.atoms) Do ..flattenlist(p1,.atoms) ;zw flat1,atoms ; "classname" ; flat1=$lb($lb("String","PXW.DEV.UnitTests.ClassToDisplay")) If atoms.Count()=1,$PIECE(atoms.GetAt(1).type,":",1)="String" { Set class=atoms.GetAt(1).value } ; ..%ClassName(1) ; flat1=$lb($lb("ObjectMemberIdentifier","%ClassName"),$lb("Number","1")) If atoms.Count()=2,$$$UPPER(atoms.GetAt(1).value)="%CLASSNAME" { Set class=..This } ; $classname() ; flat1=$lb($lb("keyword","classname")) If atoms.Count()=1,$$$UPPER(atoms.GetAt(1).value)="CLASSNAME" { Set class=..This } ; ----- P2 (query) If class'="" { Kill atoms ;Set flat2=..flattenlist(p2,.atoms) Do ..flattenlist(p2,.atoms) ; "classname" ; flat=$lb($lb("String","PXW.DEV.UnitTests.ClassToDisplay")) If atoms.Count()=1,$PIECE(atoms.GetAt(1).type,":",1)="String" { Set query=atoms.GetAt(1).value Set a=atoms.GetAt(1) Do ..wrapAtomHTML(a,"","") } } } } If ClassName="%Library.ResultSet",MethodPath=".%New" { Set paramsE=Element.findFirstElementByType("FunctionParameterList") Do paramsE.findElementsByType("FunctionParameter",.plist,0) If $ISOBJECT($GET(plist)) { Kill atoms Set p1=plist.GetAt(1) ;Set flat=..flattenlist(p1,.atoms) Do ..flattenlist(p1,.atoms) ; "%Studio.Project:ProjectList ; flat=$lb($lb("String","%Studio.Project:ProjectList")) If atoms.Count()=1,$PIECE(atoms.GetAt(1).type,":",1)="String" { Set val=atoms.GetAt(1).value Set class=$PIECE(val,":",1) Set query=$PIECE(val,":",2) Set a=atoms.GetAt(1) Do ..wrapAtomHTML(a,"","") } ; ..%ClassName(1)_":ProjectList" ;=flat=$lb($lb("ObjectChainNoDot","%ClassName"),$lb("Number","1"),$lb("String",":ProjectList")) If atoms.Count()=3,$$$UPPER(atoms.GetAt(1).value)="%CLASSNAME",$PIECE(atoms.GetAt(3).type,":",1)="String" { Set class=..This Set query=$PIECE(atoms.GetAt(3).value,":",2) Set a=atoms.GetAt(3) Do ..wrapAtomHTML(a,"","") } ; "
		Set output=##class(PXW.Tools.DEV.HTML.bnf).%New()
		Set output.This=Include
		Set output.ThisType=..#CodeType
        Set output.BookMark=MacroToHilite
		Set output.Analyser=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Analyse.analyser).NewForLanguage(..#CodeType,"COS")
		Set output.Analyser.ClassServer=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).OpenNamespace(%NS)
		Set scratch=output
		If Debug="$PATHS" Set output.showPaths=1,%path=""

		Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
        Set x=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.COS).%New()
        Set x.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text)
	
		Try {
			;Set ok=x.CosCodeBlock(element)
			set ok=x.CosStatement(element)
			while ok {
				;If 'ok $$$ThrowStatus($$$ERROR(5001,"Could not parse"))
				Set x.element=element

				Do output.Analyser.checkElement(element)
				;W !,"------------",! D element.write()
				Do output.middle(element)
				Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
				set ok=x.CosStatement(element)
			}
		} Catch e {
			Do ..WriteStatus(e.AsStatus())
		}
		;zw zh
		Write "
" } Else { Do ..WriteStatus(sc) }

Method.name: WriteRoutine
Method.Implementation:
If $PIECE(Routine,".",*)="MAC" Set Routine=$PIECE(Routine,".",1,*-1) Set zh=$ZHOROLOG Set server=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.MAC).OpenNamespace(%NS) Set sc=server.GetRoutineStudioText(Routine,.text,.linesOfCode) Set zh(1)=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG If $$$ISOK(sc) { ;s parser=##class(PXW.DEV.ClassDefinition.Parser).NewFromString(text) Write "
"
		Set output=##class(PXW.Tools.DEV.HTML.bnf).%New()
		Set output.HiliteLabel=Label
		Set output.HilitePlus=Plus
		Set output.ClassServer=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).OpenNamespace(%NS)
		Set output.ThisType=..#CodeType
		Set scratch=output
		If Debug="$PATHS" Set output.showPaths=1

		Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
        Set parser=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.COS).%New()
        Set parser.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text) 
		Set zh(2)=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG
		Try {
			Set ok=parser.CosCodeBlock(element)
			If 'ok $$$ThrowStatus($$$ERROR(5001,"Could not parse"))
			Set zh(3)=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG
			Set parser.element=element

			Set zh(4)=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG
			Do output.middle(element)
			Set zh(5)=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG
			If 'parser.stream.EOF() {
				Write ""
				Do ..WriteStatus($$$ERROR(5001,"Not at end:line="_x.stream.line_":pos="_x.stream.pos_":lastPos="_x.stream.lastPos_":length="_x.stream.length_":"_$EXTRACT(x.stream.input,x.stream.pos,x.stream.lastPos)_"."))
				Write ""
				Do output.AddToIndex(" Unfinished parse","ERROR","unfinishedParse")
				Do output.AddToIndexError(" Unfinished parse","Unfinished parsing")
			}

		} Catch e {
			Do ..WriteStatus(e.AsStatus())
		}
		;ZWrite zh
		Write "
" } Else { Do ..WriteStatus(sc) }

New %path Kill %pxw1 #dim ele,element as PXW.DEV.Element Set zh=$ZHOROLOG Set output=##class(PXW.Tools.DEV.HTML.bnf).%New() Set output.ClassServer=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).%OpenId(%NS) Set showPaths=0 Write "
"
	If +Debug=1 $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Tools.DebugTiming).%ClassName(1))
	If Debug["$TIME" $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Tools.DebugTiming).%ClassName(1))
	If Debug["$FILE" $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Debuggers.BasicToFile).%ClassName(1)) 
	If Debug["$PATHS" Set showPaths=1,%path="" ; no need to set any output its just for tooltips
	
	;s sc=output.ClassServer.GetClassStudioText(ClassName,.text,.linesOfCode,.timestamp)
    Set pythonserver=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.PythonObject).%OpenId(%NS)
    Set sc=pythonserver.GetModule(ClassName,.text,.linesOfCode,.lastUpdate)
	Set zh(1,"load")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

	If $$$ISOK(sc) {
		If Debug'="" {
			; display the original text from the server
			Write "
"
            Write "loaded",!
			;zw text,linesOfCode
			Set ln=""
			For  {
				Set ln=$ORDER(linesOfCode(ln))
				Quit:ln=""
				Write !,""_ln_":"_""_..EscapeHTML(linesOfCode(ln))
			}
			Write "
"
		}
		Set zh(2,"display")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

        Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
		If Debug["$NEW" {
			Write "running in new mode"
        	;s x=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.ClassDefinitionAuto).%New()
		} Else {
			Set x=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.Python).%New()
		}
        Set x.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text)
		Set zh=$ZHOROLOG

		Set output.This=ClassName
		Set output.HiLiteLine=hiliteLineNo
		Set output.BookMark=bookMark
		Set output.showPaths=showPaths
        Do output.begin()
		Set scratch=output
		Set zh(4,"render")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

		Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
        /*		while x.cheese(element) {
			;d element.write("")
			d output.middle(element)
			;zw output.Analyser
			s element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New()
		}*/
        If x.File(element) {
        	If Debug["$OUTFILE" {
                $$$DEBUGNew(##class(PXW.Debuggers.BasicToFile).%ClassName(1)) 
                #dim deb as PXW.Debuggers.BasicToFile=%pxwdebug
                Do deb.UseFile() Do element.writeFull() Do deb.UseIO()
            }
            Do output.middle(element)
		    Do output.end()
        } Else {
            Write "Failed to parse",!
            Do element.write()
            Do output.middle(element)
    	    Do output.end()
        }

		Set zh(5,"render end")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG

		;Set xref=##class(PXW.Xref.Build).%New()
		;zw ClassName,timestamp
		;d xref.xrefClassIfNecessary(%NS,ClassName,timestamp,0,text)

		;Set zh(6,"xref")=$ZHOROLOG-zh,zh=$ZHOROLOG
		Kill element,x,output

	} Else {
		Do ..WriteStatus(sc)
		;s xref=##class(PXW.Xref.Build).%New()
		;d xref.xrefClassIfNecessary(ClassName,"",0)

	}
	If Debug["$TIME" {
		
		Set s="" For  Set s=$ORDER(%pxwstrings(s),1,n) Quit:s=""  Set %pxwstringsX(n,s)=""
		Write "
" ZWrite %pxwstrings,%pxwstringsX,%pxw1,%RBCOUNT Write "
"
		Set totaltime=0,totalcalls=0
		Set rs=##clasS(%Library.ResultSet).%New("PXW.Tools.DebugTiming:SelectResults")
		$$$THROWONERROR(sc,rs.%Execute())
		&html<>
		While rs.%Next() {
			Set time=rs.Get("TotalTime"),totaltime=totaltime+time
			Set calls=rs.Get("CountOfCalls"),totalcalls=totalcalls+calls
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write ""
			Write "",!
		}
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write ""
		Write "",!
		&html<

			
ClassNameMethodNameTotalTimeCountOfCallsAverageTimePercentageOfTime
"_..EscapeHTML(rs.Get("ClassName"))_""_""_..EscapeHTML(rs.Get("MethodName"))_""_""_$JUSTIFY(time,0,6)_""_calls_""_$JUSTIFY(rs.Get("AverageTime"),0,6)_""_$JUSTIFY(rs.Get("PercentageOfTime"),0,6)_"
Total"_""_""_$JUSTIFY(totaltime,0,6)_""_totalcalls_""_""_""_""_"
>
	} Else {
		;w "
" zw %pxwstrings,%pxwstringsX,%pxw1 
		;w !,"$s="_$s
		;w "
"
		
	}
	If Debug="$FILE" {
		ZWrite %pxwdebug
	}
	;d %session.EndSession()
	;zw zh
    Write "

Class.name: PXW.Tools.Page
Class.Description:
The base page for all PXW Tools.

It sets up the overall look of each page. This is not an application that has a static page and loads data into it. All pages are created from scratch every time. This makes thing more simple for me.

Override the Write* methods to insert into HTML into the page.

Override the HREFTo method so that tools can get a HREF TO a page: ; create a link to the class display page to display this class write "Tools"

Parameter.name: ToolType
Parameter.Description: What type of tool this is: Code tools are used for display/searching code Internal tools are used for changing things about the tool itself

Parameter.name: ToolName
Parameter.Description: The name of the tool on the main home page (index). If the tool does not have a name then it does not appear on the index page by default.

Parameter.name: ToolRelatesToCodeType
Parameter.Description: Set this to a CodeType that this tool is "related" to. EG, if this is set to CLS then the tool will only appear on the home page of Namespaces that have a CLS CodeDisplay Page

Method.name: OnPreHTTP
Method.Description:
This sets up some floating % variables that can be accessed at any time.
  • %NS is the currently selected Namespace.
  • %STYLE is the currently selected Style.

#dim %request as %CSP.Request #dim %session as %CSP.Session #dim %response as %CSP.Response

Method.name: HREFTo
Method.Description:
This should return a string of the href to this page based on the input parameters. There is a convention used that each parameter of this method should add a parameter to the URL using only the capital letters of the parameter, this is only so that we can build a simple form generate page. ClassMethod HREFTo(ClassName as %String,Method as %String) as %String { set href=##super() set href=href_"&CN="_..EscapeURL(ClassName) set href=href_"&M="_..EscapeURL(Method) quit href }

Use This as a template for the comments of all the override methods.

p1
Method.Implementation: Set href=..%ClassName(1)_".cls" Set sep="?" Set href=href_sep_"%NS="_..EscapeURL($GET(%NS,"LOCAL_USER")),sep="&" Set:$GET(%NS)'=$GET(%NSORIGINAL) href=href_sep_"%NSO="_..EscapeURL($GET(%NSORIGINAL,"LOCAL_USER")),sep="&" ;s href=href_sep_"C="_..EscapeURL(cls),sep="&" Quit href

Query.SqlQuery: SELECT TOP 1000 NameSpace ,ItemType ,ItemKey1 ,ItemKey2 ,LineNumber ,Type ,Description FROM PXW_Xref.AnalysisData WHERE NameSpace=:NameSpace --IF ItemType'="" AND ItemType=:ItemType --ENDIF --IF ItemKey1'="" --IF $E(ItemKey1,*)="*" AND ItemKey1 %STARTSWITH $PIECE(:ItemKey1,'*',1) --ELSE AND ItemKey1 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:ItemKey1) --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF ItemKey2'="" --IF ItemKey2["*" AND UPPER(ItemKey2) LIKE (UPPER(:ItemKey2)) --ELSE AND UPPER(ItemKey2) %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(UPPER(:ItemKey2)) --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF Type'="" --IF $E(Type,*)="*" AND Type %STARTSWITH $PIECE(:Type,'*',1) --ELSE AND Type %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:Type) --ENDIF --ENDIF ORDER BY ItemKey1,ItemKey2

Query.name: GetByDate
Query.SqlQuery: SELECT TOP 1000 lu.NameSpace ,lu.LastUpdate ,lu.ItemType ,lu.ItemKey1 ,ad. ItemKey2 ,ad.LineNumber ,ad.Type ,ad.Description FROM PXW_Xref.LastUpdated AS lu INNER JOIN PXW_Xref.AnalysisData AS ad ON ad.Namespace=lu.Namespace and ad.ItemType=lu.ItemType and ad.ItemKey1=lu.ItemKey1 WHERE lu.NameSpace=:NameSpace AND lu.LastUpdate>:LastUpdatedSince --IF ItemType'="" AND lu.ItemType=:ItemType --ENDIF --IF ItemKey1'="" --IF $E(ItemKey1,*)="*" AND lu.ItemKey1 %STARTSWITH $PIECE(:ItemKey1,'*',1) --ELSE AND lu.ItemKey1 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:ItemKey1) --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF ItemKey2'="" --IF ItemKey2["*" AND UPPER(ad.ItemKey2) LIKE (UPPER(:ItemKey2)) --ELSE AND UPPER(ad.ItemKey2) %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(UPPER(:ItemKey2)) --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF Type'="" --IF $E(Type,*)="*" AND ad.Type %STARTSWITH $PIECE(:Type,'*',1) --ELSE AND ad.Type %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:Type) --ENDIF --ENDIF ORDER BY lu.LastUpdate DESC, lu.ItemKey1, ad.ItemKey2

Method.name: Build
Method.Description:
do ##class(PXW.Xref.Build).Build("LOCAL_USER","","PXW*") s %pxwdeb=##class(PXW.Debuggers.BasicToFile).%New(),%pxwdeb.AddDateTime=1 d ##class(PXW.Xref.Build).Build("LOCAL_USER","","*",1)
This will build either 1 or many items based of the given: Namespace - leave blank for all. Type - leave blank for all or CLS for classes, INT for routines etc. Package - A wild card search - * for all, PXW* for PXW*. Not a true wildcard, PXW*Build* will build PXW* only. Force - Normally only classes that have changed need building, use the force flag to build "stale" data. DebugBuild - If there is a debug log happening, the actual build of the data will NOT go into the log unless this flag is set. The reason is that the debug being turned on BEFORE this method is called implies you are debugging THIS, rather than all the sub classes, Until I get cleverer about how the debugger works we are stuck with a flag in the parameters!
Multiple builds can be run at once if you are sensible. Do not do a something like a force build of everything while smaller build is running. You will end up purging data that has just been built. Instead, do the large force build first to get the old data purged and then do the packages in parallel.

Method.name: DailyBuild
Method.Description: Stick a call to this somewhere so that it gets called often, it should ensure that a full build is done at least 1 time per day write ##class(PXW.Xref.Build).DailyBuild("LOCAL_USER")
Method.Implementation: Set started=0 Set rs=..SelectDailyBuildFunc() While rs.%Next() { Job ..Build(rs.Namespace,"","*",0) Hang 1 Set started=1 } Quit started

Query.name: SelectDailyBuild
Query.Description: A list of namespaces where there has not been a build today
Query.SqlQuery: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT nsp."Name" as Namespace ,(SELECT MAX(StartDate) FROM PXW_Xref.BuildStatus AS bs WHERE bs.RequestNamespace=nsp.Name) AS StartDate FROM PXW_DEV_Dictionary.Namespace as nsp ) WHERE (StartDate IS NULL) OR (StartDate<CURRENT_DATE)

Query.name: SelectHourlyBuild
Query.Description: A list of namespaces where there has not been a build today
Query.SqlQuery: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT nsp."Name" as Namespace ,(SELECT MAX(StartDateTime) FROM PXW_Xref.BuildStatus AS bs WHERE bs.RequestNamespace=nsp.Name) AS StartDateTime FROM PXW_DEV_Dictionary.Namespace as nsp ) WHERE (StartDateTime IS NULL) OR (StartDateTime<dateadd(minute,-60,current_timestamp))

Query.name: SelectTypes

;;; YUCK Set %NS=Namespace
Set sc=$$$OK
Set ClassServer=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).OpenNamespace(Namespace) Set text=PreLoadedText
Do ClassServer.CacheClearClassDetails(ItemKey1,1) ; pretend the class is deleted so that it REALLY clears it
If $$$ISOK(sc) { Set ..ClassServer=ClassServer Set ..This=$SELECT($$$UPPER($PIECE(ItemKey1,".",*))="CLS":$PIECE(ItemKey1,".",1,*-1),1:ItemKey1) Try { Set x=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.ClassDefinition).%New() Set x.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text)
Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New() $$$DEBUGPause While x.cheese(element) { $$$DEBUGResume Do ..xrefElement(element) $$$DEBUGPause If ..ERROR'="" $$$ThrowStatus($$$ERROR(5001,..ERROR)) Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New() } $$$DEBUGResume If 'x.stream.EOF() Set sc=$$$ERROR(5001,"Not at end:"_x.stream.line_":"_x.stream.pos_":"_x.stream.length_":"_$EXTRACT(x.stream.input,x.stream.lastPos,x.stream.lastPos+20)) } Catch e { Set sc=e.AsStatus() $$$DEBUG("ERROR: "_e.AsSystemError()) } } Quit sc

Method.name: flattenlist
Method.Description:
This method needs to be somewhere that XREF and HTML can access. Part of the analyser maybe? It takes an element that is a list of things (eg a method call parameters) and flattens them for easy examination. EG: ..%ClassName(1)_":ProjectList" flat = $lb($lb("ObjectChainNoDot","%ClassName"),$lb("Number","1"),$lb("String",":ProjectList"))
It might be better to use the xpath functions now, instead of this, but leaving alone.

Method.name: Build
Build
Method.Implementation:
; THIS WOULD BE REALLY NICE TO DO ; BUT THERE IS JUST TOO MUCH CODE
QUIT $$$OK
; IF WE COULD DO JUST GENERATED METHODS OR CERTAIN MACROS IT WOULD BE GOOD
#dim ele as PXW.DEV.Element
Set sc=$$$OK
Set ClassServer=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).OpenNamespace(Namespace) Set text=PreLoadedText
;Do ClassServer.CacheClearClassDetails(ItemKey1,1) ; pretend the class is deleted so that it REALLY clears it
If $$$ISOK(sc) { set ..Analyser=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Analyse.analyser).NewForLanguage(..#CodeType,"COS") Set ..ClassServer=ClassServer Set ..CalledByClassName=ItemKey1 Set ..This=$p($s($$$UPPER($p(ItemKey1,".",*))="INT":$p(ItemKey1,".",1,*-1),1:ItemKey1),".",1,*-1) ; get rid of 1.INT from the end Try { Set parser=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.COS).%New() Set parser.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text)
Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New() if parser.CosCodeBlock(element) { Do ..xrefElement(element) If ..ERROR'="" $$$ThrowStatus($$$ERROR(5001,..ERROR)) Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New() } If 'parser.stream.EOF() Set sc=$$$ERROR(5001,"Not at end:"_parser.stream.line_":"_parser.stream.pos_":"_parser.stream.length_":"_$EXTRACT(parser.stream.input,parser.stream.lastPos,parser.stream.lastPos+20)) } Catch e { Set sc=e.AsStatus() } } Quit sc

Class.name: PXW.Xref.Data
Class.Description:
Xref Data is made up of 2 parts: Item: ItemType, ItemKey1, ItemKey2 makes up the part of the thing being referenced. Caller: CalledByType, CalledByCommand, CalledByKey1, CalledByKey2, CalledByKey3, LineNumber make up the information about where the item is being used.
ItemType and CalledByType will be the Type of code referenced, used to work out what code to display (EG. CLS for a Objectscript Class) ItemKey1 and CalledByKey1 will be the main key of the code (EG the class name) ItemKey2 and CalledByKey2 will be the section of the code to look at (EG method name) CalledByKey3 will be a even more precise location of the code where the object was called (EG. line number in the method) LineNumber will be a precise location of the code, (EG the line number in the file) CalledByCommand will be a thing used for indexing so we can look up all VariableSets or _Overrides etc.

Property.name: ItemType
Property.Description: Class, Global, Routine

Property.name: ItemKey1
Property.Description: Name of Class, Global, Routine

Property.name: ItemKey2
Property.Description: Method of Class, Subscripts of global or Label of routine

Property.name: CalledByType
Property.Description: What is referencing this thing (class, routine)

Property.name: CalledByCommand
Property.Description: The command used for the call (set/kill)

Property.name: CalledByKey1
Property.Description: The routine, class doing the call

Property.name: CalledByKey2
Property.Description: Line label, method

Property.name: CalledByKey3
Property.Description: label relative number

Property.name: LineNumber
Property.Description: absolute line number within the entire class text, or routine text

Property.name: Parameters
Property.Description: data relating to this specific call (label parameters, global subscripts etc)

Property.name: CalledBySection
Property.Description: Name of the section of code this is in. EG the code: <example> Q A S X=1 S Y=2 1 S Z=3 ; this is in section A Q </example>

Class.name: PXW.Xref.LastUpdatedDetails
Class.ViewQuery: --- This might not be the most efficient query for this job, but good for testing parsing of sql WITH xcount AS ( select "Namespace",CalledByType,CalledByKey1 ,count(*) as XrefCount from pxw_xref.data group by CalledByType,CalledByKey1 ),ycount as ( select "Namespace",ItemType,ItemKey1 ,count(*) as XrefCount from pxw_xref.data group by ItemType,ItemKey1 ) SELECT lu.Namespace, lu.ItemType, lu.ItemKey1, lu.BuiltAt, lu.LastUpdate as LastUpdateOnServer , atel.ServerAddress, atel."Namespace" as ServerNamespace, lastupdateddetails_myformat(atel."Namespace") as formattedNs, xd.XrefCount as CallsCount, yd.XrefCount as UsedCount, ( select count(*)+xd.XrefCount+yd.XrefCount from pxw_xref.data as xx where xx."namespace"=lu."namespace" and xx.ItemType=lu.itemtype and xx.ItemKey1=lu.itemkey1 and xx.calledbykey1!=xx.itemKey1 ) as RanddomFormula FROM pxw_xref.lastupdated as lu LEFT OUTER JOIN pxw_dev_dictionary.classdefinitionobject as cdo on cdo."namespace"=lu."namespace" LEFT OUTER JOIN pxw_dev_dictionary.ateliersettings as atel on atel.id=cdo.ateliersettings LEFT OUTER JOIN xcount as xd ON xd."namespace"=lu."namespace" and xd.CalledByType=lu.itemtype and xd.CalledByKey1=lu.itemkey1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ycount as yd ON yd."namespace"=lu."namespace" and yd.ItemType=lu.itemtype and yd.ItemKey1=lu.itemkey1

Query.name: Get
Query.Description: <dl> <dt>ItemType</dt><dd>Class, Global, Rtn etc</dd> <dt>ItemKey1</dt><dd>Class name ,may be a single string, a comma separated list OR contain wildcard (*), you cannot mix , and *</dd> <dt>ItemKey2</dt><dd>Method name, may be a comma separated list, its possible that this is a * (select * from) so this is treated as a special case</dd> <dt>CalledByKey2</dt><dd>Class name, may be a comma separated list</dd> </dl> Flags: string containing the following flags: EXTERNAL : only list rows where the call is External
Query.SqlQuery: SELECT NameSpace,ItemType,ItemKey1,ItemKey2, CalledByType,CalledByCommand,CalledByKey1,CalledByKey2,CalledByKey3,LineNumber,Parameters, PXW_Xref.Queries_GetCode(NameSpace,CalledByType,CalledByKey1,LineNumber,:WindowSize) AS CallingCode FROM PXW_Xref.Data WHERE NameSpace=:NameSpace --IF ItemType'="" AND ItemType=:ItemType --ENDIF --IF ItemKey1'="" --IF ItemKey1["," AND ItemKey1 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:ItemKey1) --ELSEIF ItemKey1["*" AND ItemKey1 LIKE replace(replace(:ItemKey1,'%','\%'),'*','%') ESCAPE '\' --ELSE AND ItemKey1=:ItemKey1 --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF ItemKey2'="" --IF ItemKey2["," AND ItemKey2 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:ItemKey2) --ELSEIF ItemKey2="*" AND ItemKey2=:ItemKey2 --ELSEIF ItemKey2["*" AND ItemKey2 LIKE replace(replace(:ItemKey2,'%','\%'),'*','%') ESCAPE '\' --ELSE AND ItemKey2=:ItemKey2 --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF CalledByKey1'="" --IF CalledByKey1["," AND CalledByKey1 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:CalledByKey1) --ELSEIF CalledByKey1["*" AND CalledByKey1 LIKE replace(replace(:CalledByKey1,'%','\%'),'*','%') ESCAPE '\' --ELSE AND CalledByKey1=:CalledByKey1 --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF CalledByKey2'="" --IF CalledByKey2["," AND CalledByKey2 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:CalledByKey2) --ELSEIF CalledByKey1["*" AND CalledByKey2 LIKE replace(replace(:CalledByKey2,'%','\%'),'*','%') ESCAPE '\' --ELSE AND CalledByKey2=:CalledByKey2 --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF CalledByCommand'="" AND CalledByCommand=:CalledByCommand --ENDIF --IF Flags["EXTERNAL" AND CalledByKey1!=ItemKey1 --ENDIF --IF CodeSearch'="",WindowSize>0 AND UPPER(PXW_Xref.Queries_GetCode(NameSpace,CalledByType,CalledByKey1,LineNumber,:WindowSize)) LIKE UPPER(replace(replace(:CodeSearch,'%','\%'),'*','%')) ESCAPE '\' --ENDIF ORDER BY --IF Flags["BY CALLED" CalledByKey1,CalledByKey2,LineNumber, --ENDIF ItemKey1,ItemKey2

Query.name: GetSuper
Query.Description: Include all the calls to the same method in the superclasses. EG there may be no direct call to the method you are looking at, but it is called because its an override of a superclass and the superclass method gets called. Could this replace Get query entirely? IE in Get mode GetOverrideTree returns only 1 row... Needs testing.
Query.SqlQuery: SELECT dat.NameSpace,dat.ItemType,dat.ItemKey1,dat.ItemKey2, dat.CalledByType,dat.CalledByCommand,dat.CalledByKey1,dat.CalledByKey2,dat.CalledByKey3,dat.LineNumber,dat.Parameters, PXW_Xref.Queries_GetCode(dat.NameSpace,dat.CalledByType,dat.CalledByKey1,dat.LineNumber,:WindowSize) AS CallingCode FROM PXW_Xref.Queries_GetOverrideTree(:NameSpace,:ItemKey1,:ItemKey2) as overs INNER JOIN PXW_Xref.Data as dat ON dat.NameSpace=%SQLUPPER(overs.NameSpace) AND ((overs.itemkey1 IS NULL) OR (dat.itemkey1=%SQLUPPER(overs.itemkey1))) AND ((overs.itemkey2 IS NULL) OR (dat.itemkey2=%SQLUPPER(overs.itemkey2))) WHERE 1=1 --IF ItemType'="" AND dat.ItemType=:ItemType --ENDIF --IF CalledByKey1'="" --IF $E(CalledByKey1,*)="*" AND dat.CalledByKey1 %STARTSWITH $PIECE(:CalledByKey1,'*',1) --ELSE AND dat.CalledByKey1 %INLIST $LISTFROMSTRING(:CalledByKey1) --ENDIF --ENDIF --IF CalledByCommand'="" AND dat.CalledByCommand=:CalledByCommand --ENDIF --IF Flags["EXTERNAL" AND dat.CalledByKey1!=dat.ItemKey1 --ENDIF ORDER BY --IF Flags["BY CALLED" dat.CalledByKey1,dat.CalledByKey2,dat.CalledByKey3, --ENDIF dat.ItemKey1,dat.ItemKey2

Method.name: GetCountsSummary
Method.Implementation: $$$DEBUGMethodBegin Set count="" Set rs=..GetCountsSummaryFunc(NameSpace,ItemType,ItemKey1) Set Results=0 while rs.%Next() { Set ik2=rs.%Get("ItemKey2") Set cbc=rs.%Get("CalledByCommand") Set count=+rs.%Get("Number") Set Results=$g(Results)+count Set Results(ik2)=$g(Results(ik2))+count Set Results(ik2,cbc)=$g(Results(ik2,cbc))+count } $$$DEBUGMethodEnd Quit count

Method.name: GetOverrideTreeExecute

Kill %PXWTree,%PXWTreeDone Set %PXWTree($INCREMENT(%PXWTree))=$LISTBUILD(NameSpace,ItemKey1,ItemKey2) ; include self Do gettreerecurse(NameSpace,ItemKey1,ItemKey2) Set qHandle="" Quit $$$OK gettreerecurse(NameSpace,ItemKey1,ItemKey2) If $DATA(%PXWTreeDone(ItemKey1)) Quit
Set %PXWTreeDone(ItemKey1)=1 Set rs=..GetOverridesFunc(NameSpace,ItemKey1,ItemKey2) While rs.%Next() { Set %PXWTree($INCREMENT(%PXWTree))=$LISTBUILD(rs.NameSpace,rs.ItemKey1,rs.ItemKey2) Do gettreerecurse(NameSpace,rs.ItemKey1,ItemKey2) } Quit

/* Do ^%SYS.MONLBL ; for starting the monitor via a menu
; or do it in a command ; default metrics will do Set status=##class(%Monitor.System.LineByLine).Start($lb("PXW.DEV.BNF.GEN.COS*","PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.COS*"),"",$lb($J)) d ##class(PXW.samples.parsetest).go("%Library.RegisteredObject")
USER>Do ^%SYS.MONLBL
Line-by-Line Monitor
1.) Stop Monitor 2.) Pause Monitor 3.) Clear Counters 4.) Report - Detail 5.) Report - Summary 6.) Report - Delimited (CSV) Output 7.) Report - Procedure Level
Enter the number of your choice: 6
The following routines have been executed during the run, and have detail statistics available for them. 1 outine number (*=All)? * - All
FileName: /home/irisowner/dev/debug/MON.txt
*/

Method.name: go
Method.Implementation:
New %path Kill %pxw1 #dim ele,element as PXW.DEV.Element
Set cs=##class(PXW.DEV.Dictionary.ClassDefinitionObject).OpenNamespace("LOCAL_USER") set sc=cs.GetClassStudioText(ClassName,.text,.linesOfCode,.timestamp)
if 'sc d $system.OBJ.DisplayError(sc) q
Set x=##class(PXW.DEV.BNF.Run.ClassDefinition).%New() Set x.stream=##class(PXW.DEV.InputStream).NewString(text)
Set sc=##class(%Monitor.System.LineByLine).Start($lb("PXW.DEV*"),"",$lb($J)) d $system.Status.DisplayError(sc)
s pzh=$zh,ptot=0 Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New() While x.cheese(element) { Set element=##class(PXW.DEV.Element).%New() } s ptot=ptot+($zh-pzh) zw ptot
d ..Print() d ##class(%Monitor.System.LineByLine).Stop()

Method.name: test
Print
Method.Implementation:
s oldio=$io s metrics=##class(%Monitor.System.LineByLine).GetMetrics(),cnt=$l(metrics,",")
set dt=$TRANSLATE($ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,3),":- ","") Set file="/home/irisowner/dev/debug/MON_"_dt_".csv" o file:"WN" u file w "LineByLine,Rtn" s sep="," f i=1:1:cnt { s met=$p(metrics,",",i) u file w sep_met s sep="," } u file w ",Method,Code"
s rcount=##class(%Monitor.System.LineByLine).GetRoutineCount() f ri=1:1:rcount { s rtn=##class(%Monitor.System.LineByLine).GetRoutineName(ri) u 0 w !,rtn s rset=##class(%ResultSet).%New("%Monitor.System.LineByLine:Result") d rset.Execute(rtn) s method="" f l=1:1 s more=rset.Next() q:'more d . s x=rset.GetData(1) . u file w !,l,",",rtn,"," f i=1:1:cnt w $li(x,i),"," . s lbl="+"_l_"^"_rtn . s code=$t(@lbl) . s code=$replace(code,"""","""""") . i code["methodimpl {" s method=$p(code,"(",1) . u file w method_","_""""_code_"""" k rset } c file u oldio
q $$$OK
